attributes.title: NatCon 2027
attributes.venue: New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ANCC CH · APA CE · NBCC
attributes.summary:
NatCon 2027 is the annual conference of the National Council for Mental Wellbeing. It runs April 12 to 14, 2027, at the New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center. People attending a preconference or the Mental Health First Aid Summit start earlier in the week. The organizer expects more than 5,000 attendees and 500 speakers.

Registration has three price stages. Early rates run until January 12, 2027: $975 for 100% association members, $1,025 for members and $1,275 for non-members. Advance rates of $1,075, $1,125 and $1,375 apply until February 26. Standard rates are $1,175, $1,225 and $1,475. The pricing page prints the early cutoff as January 12, 2026, which looks like a typo, because the same page says rates rise on January 13.

The National Council says it is applying for credit through ACCME, ANCC, APA, NASW, NBCC, NAADAC and the New York State social work and mental health counselor boards. The approvals and credit totals are not confirmed yet. Hotels are booked through the official onPeak block after registration.
